purpose: Define an offline-validated future rewrite schema that makes the public observation and comparison obligations machine-verifiable.

future_only_changes.rewrite_schema: Structured JSON with reasoning and final plus separately enumerable visual_observations and candidate_comparisons.
future_only_changes.direct_route_boundary: Direct rewrites may refer only to visible image/question evidence and must not name classifier, retrieval, RAG, scores, or ranks.
future_only_changes.validation: Require at least three independent observations and three candidate-comparison entries before rendering the four-section student-visible reasoning.
future_only_changes.fixed_final: The final answer remains byte-identical to the closed public parent.

offline_acceptance: Historical failure analysis is reproduced without provider calls.
Schema/parser/validator tests cover Direct and tool-using routes, English and Chinese, Option answer projection, private-boundary rejection, and fixed-final preservation.
No historical rejected rewrite is converted or relabelled accepted by this patch.
provider_policy: After E3 aggregation and offline acceptance, only a separately authorized 8-cell x 1 new-lineage pilot may use provider calls; R0/R1/R2 recovery and independent rewrite audit remain mandatory.
